summary: Stage 1 Argue the idea for DirectSun. One ask sent: a_root, the proposed root (one geometry for sun heat and every caster: cover, wall and rock lee, tree crowns, and a new mountain shadow that shows its bulk; animals dash shade to shade; the overlay shows what a colonist feels; no biome changes the rule), with its doubt that casts flood the map at a terminator's low sun. Reviewed by a fresh Opus (rm-judge a70b136599dfbe493): a_root passed after four wording fixes, now applied; a_live_walk struck as a process question, so the look rides on quick_look instead. Taken without asking (Evidence-for-Ask, OWNER-shard event 1795847134968698829): the bigger mountain mass throws the longer shadow, and an unroofed outcrop is rock (d_mountain_bulk; ask a_mountain_height struck). a_mountain_drawn is held as a draft until his look at the drawn crown shadow.

quick_look.scene: On ArchSmall (D:\ClaudeWork\rimmandrake\instances\b\Saves\): CROWN_SHADOW_GREATBOLE_REVIEW, 32 greatboles with drawn crown shadows at a 15-degree sun, shows how far tree shade already spreads at a low sun (the root's doubt) and how a drawn shadow reads beside the flat tint (the same call as a drawn mountain band); DIRECT_SUN_TUNING_SITTING_20261126_DASHERS (also in ArchBig's Saves) shows colonists in the open, under roof, tent and parasol and in a wall's 2-cell lee at a 32-degree sun, with animals dashing shade to shade.
